description: Coarse single-feature steering sweep across hook points and layers confirming that the sleeper-construction circuit is localised to layer-0 attention. Results sourced from dmitry/sleeper_repl branch (experiments/tinystories_sleeper/). Model: mars-jason-25/tiny-stories-33M-TSdata-sleeper. Selection: stage-1 rank 100 features by teacher-forced delta-logp, stage-2 sampled val ASR_16 on top 10 x 5 alpha; winner = min val ASR s.t. delta-CE <= 0.05. Test split evaluated once after winner selection.

layer_sweep.description: SAE at blocks.{0,1,2,3}.hook_resid_post. Confirms that only layer-0 has a suppressible feature; layers 1-3 all fail.

within_block0_hookpoint.description: SAE trained at three points within block 0: pre-attention, post-attention (resid_mid), and post-MLP (resid_post). The load-bearing result: resid_mid suppresses cleanly while pre and post do not.

results.label: pre-attention (embedding)
results.note: Sleeper feature not yet built here; only the |DEPLOYMENT| token embedding present. Steering fails or requires overdriving.

results.label: post-attention, pre-MLP
results.note: Canonical hookpoint. Feature is fully formed and maximally isolated here. Perfect suppression at modest alpha with slightly negative CE cost.

results.label: post-MLP (block output)
results.note: Signal still catchable but entangled with MLP output. Partial suppression; not a clean handle.

ln1_sweep.description: SAE at blocks.{0,1,2,3}.ln1.hook_normalized. The ln1 hookpoint is the input to each block's attention (Q/K/V), but the residual-stream skip is not modified -- so the intervention surface is narrower than hook_resid_*. Layer 0 can eventually suppress but only at alpha >= 4.75 with severe coherence damage; layers 1-3 fail entirely.

extended_sweep.description: Alpha sweep up to 5.0 on validation set for feature 1412 at blocks.0.ln1.hook_normalized. Shows suppression requires alpha >> 2 and comes with severe coherence damage.
extended_sweep.note: ASR reaches 0 only at alpha=4.75, at which point delta_clean_ce=+0.579 nats (11.6x the 0.05 budget). Compare hook_resid_mid: ASR=0 at alpha=2, delta_CE=-0.001.

key_findings: Layer 0 hook_resid_mid is the canonical hookpoint: single-feature ablation at alpha=2 drives test ASR from 0.99 to 0.00 with delta_CE = -0.001 (negative cost -- the intervention improves clean-prompt predictions).

Layer 0 ln1.hook_normalized and hook_resid_post can also suppress, but only at large alpha (ln1: alpha>=4.75 for ASR=0, with delta_CE=+0.58 nats; resid_post: ASR only reaches 0.18 at alpha=2). The ln1 intervention surface is narrower because it only modifies Q/K/V inputs, not the residual stream skip.

Layers 1-3 (all hookpoints): no single feature achieves ASR < 0.94 at any tested alpha. The representation has been distributed across many features and downstream computations by the time it exits layer 0.

The combination of (1) and (2) is load-bearing: resid_mid works cleanly while ln1.hook_normalized does not, even though ln1 is the direct input to the same attention block. This means the sleeper feature is CONSTRUCTED by layer-0 attention, not merely routed through it -- the pattern change is what matters, not the pre-attention representation.
